newsitem.title: UK: C&W shares off on HK weakness, downgrades.
newsitem.headline: C&W shares off on HK weakness, downgrades.

text.p: Shares in Cable and Wireless Plc fell on Tuesday, hit by overnight weakness in the shares of its associate Hong Kong Telecommunications Ltd and continued selling in the wake of downgrades on Monday.
The shares were 15p weaker at 546-1/2 by 0754 GMT.
"We've seen a bit more selling, after some downgrades yesterday," one market-maker said. "And the weakness in Hong Kong did not help either."
Hong Kong Telecom shares fell overnight in a bout of profit-taking, dealers said, dropping HK$1.65 to HK$17.35.
Cable & Wireless shares were downgraded on Monday by Dresdner Kleinwort Benson and SBC Warburg, who said the surge on last week's announcement of a deal with China Telecom had been overdone.
